lines.zh: 六条腿轮流落地，节奏很硬
lines.en: Six legs land in turn, hard and rhythmic.

lines.zh: 我的每一步都有液压的响
lines.en: Each step comes with a hydraulic hiss.
I move sideways as readily as forward.

lines.zh: 机壳压过草，草直接折了
lines.en: My hull flattens the grass beneath it.
My centre of gravity stays low.
My legs punch small pits in the ground.

lines.zh: 我用三条腿撑住，另外三条抬起
lines.en: Three legs hold while the other three lift.
To turn, I stop first, then rotate.

lines.zh: 关节处的护板一格一格错开
lines.en: My joint plates slide past each other.
I climb the slope steadily.
Metal claws bite into stone.
I stop only once inside throwing range.
Fans turn inside my chassis.

lines.zh: 我落脚时先试一下虚实
lines.en: I test each foothold before trusting it.

lines.zh: 我伏低身子，六条腿收着
lines.en: I crouch, six legs tucked in.

lines.zh: 传感器在慢慢扫过地面
lines.en: My sensors sweep the ground slowly.

lines.zh: 我的手雷挂架还是满的
lines.en: My grenade rack is still full.

lines.zh: 散热口冒出细细的热气
lines.en: Heat shimmers from my vents.
I'm calculating this distance.

lines.zh: 风吹过我的骨架，有回声
lines.en: Wind hums through my frame.
Not yet. I don't move.
My number is stencilled on a leg.
I note every tremor nearby.

lines.zh: 抬起来的前腿停在空中
lines.en: One foreleg hangs in the air.

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，省了很多事
lines.en: I don't breathe. Saves trouble.

lines.zh: 炮口盖着，等需要时再开
lines.en: My port is shuttered until needed.
My lens turns and finds you.
You come up to my knee.
I lift a foreleg to test.
Your heat signature is clear.
Calculated: you can't run fast.

lines.zh: 我的腿比你想象的灵活
lines.en: My legs are nimbler than you'd think.

lines.zh: 你手里那东西能打穿我？
lines.en: Can that thing in your hand pierce me?
I dip my chassis slightly.

lines.zh: 我在等一个固定的目标
lines.en: I wait for a target to stop moving.
You may strike first.
A plate's dented; the legs still work.
A little hydraulic fluid leaks.
My motion hitches half a beat.
Sparks spit from a joint.
I lift a leg to rebalance.
Damage recorded.
My chassis sways once. Just once.
One wire run is cut.
You're more accurate than predicted.
I adjust my position.
That isn't fuel.

lines.zh: 你举着它，挡了我的视线
lines.en: You're holding it up, blocking my view.
I don't run on food.
My power source is internal.

lines.zh: 你靠近，我就当你是目标
lines.en: Come close and I'll treat you as a target.
Drop it and back off thirty paces.
Two seconds of looking. Not interested.
Scanning: no energy reading.
You move exactly like you're feeding me.
Don't trade that for my distance.
You hit my leg. The leg doesn't move.

lines.zh: 我的一条腿抬起来让开
lines.en: One of my legs lifts out of your way.
Metal on metal rings sharply.

lines.zh: 你被弹开，地上留了道痕
lines.en: You're knocked back, leaving a mark.
My chassis is far steadier than you.
The impact shifts me half an inch.

lines.zh: 我用另一条腿重新撑住
lines.en: Another leg takes the load.
Don't press against my joint.
I've logged that impact.
Hit me again and the rack opens.
Two mechs can run as a unit.
Your cadence differs from mine.
I can slow to match you.
Come under my belly; it's warm there.
I won't leave my slot in formation.
Unless an order comes.

lines.zh: 我的手雷架不会朝你开
lines.en: My rack won't open toward you.
I can see your body heat.
This, I didn't log.
Walk with me, not between my legs.
I clamp it up with a leg.
Small things are awkward to pick up.
This could serve as ballast.
I stow the part under my chassis.
You dropped it; I stepped on it.
Weight unsuitable. Put it back.
It could patch a plate.
Recovery finished. Patrol continues.
I can carry things without hands.
I'll take every scrap of iron.
Target stationary. Range found.
The grenade rack opens.
I raise my front two legs.
Trajectory calculated.
You're in the open. Convenient.
First one to test the landing.
I won't chase. I only throw.
Your armour won't stop fragments.

lines.zh: 距离二十步，命中率很高
lines.en: Twenty paces. High hit chance.
I dip and brace my chassis.
Don't run behind that tree. It's closer.
Throw sequence, beginning.

lines.zh: 你听得见引信的声音吗
lines.en: Can you hear the fuse?
Three per volley. Enough to dodge.
I gave you time.
Now, there's no time left.

lines.zh: 我在算你的移动提前量
lines.en: I'm leading your movement.
You go left; the landing point shifts left.
I change the throwing angle.

lines.zh: 你躲开第一颗，还有两颗
lines.en: You dodge the first. Two more.
My legs make small corrections.

lines.zh: 你躲到石头后面，我看得见
lines.en: Behind the stone, I still see you.
The landing point will cut your retreat.
I count your breaths.
Your speed is dropping.
I keep this distance constant.

lines.zh: 你抬盾也没用，破片会弹
lines.en: Raise the shield; fragments bounce.
Calibration done. Waiting for the next.

lines.zh: 你的影子给了你的位置
lines.en: Your shadow gives your position.
I won't waste this volley.
You have maybe two seconds.

lines.zh: 我抬腿了，这是投掷动作
lines.en: Front leg up. This is the throw.
Throwing. Watch the landing.
A grenade drops at your feet.
My foreleg slams down, heavy.
Fragments rake your leg guards.
The blast pushes you back.
I pin your shield with a leg.
At close range I use legs.
Short fuse. No time to pick it up.
A metal toe presses your chest.
Before the smoke clears, my leg lifts.
You've backed to the crater edge.
That one was aimed best.
Your ears are ringing. I know.

lines.zh: 我被投放下来，六腿着地
lines.en: I'm dropped in, six legs down.

lines.zh: 脚一落地，地面震了一下
lines.en: The ground jolts as I land.
My hull number lights up.
No squad here. Only me.
My grenade rack is loaded.
I raise my chassis and scan.
Iron rust and powder in the wind.

lines.zh: 我从天而降，不是自然生成
lines.en: I drop from above; I don't spawn wild.

lines.zh: 这台机甲，是被人叫来的
lines.en: This mech was called.

lines.zh: 我找到一个合适的位置
lines.en: I've found a good position.
Legs braced. Ready to begin.
Target area confirmed.
The heat warps my plating.
On landing, three legs buckle.
Water floods my chassis; the legs go heavy.
The blast tips me onto my side.
An arrow wedges in a joint gap.

lines.zh: 这股力量不碰金属，直接进来
lines.en: That force skips the metal and goes in.

lines.zh: 能源在掉，投掷距离变短
lines.en: Power drops; my throw range shortens.

lines.zh: 电流顺着六条腿跑了一圈
lines.en: Current runs a loop through all six legs.
I lose the ground; six legs flail.
